{{Term/Store|Guardian Resist Up||Series, BotW}} is an [[Added Effect]] in {{BotW}}.<ref>{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 280|edition= Expanded Edition|year= 2018}}</ref>

==Overview==    
Guardian Resist Up is an [[Added Effect]] that decreases the damage [[Link]] takes from [[Guardian]] enemies by 20%, 30%, and 50% for levels one, two, and three respectively. The damage reduction is calculated after Link's total [[Defense]] is subtracted from the damage of the [[Enemy]] attack. This Effect does not affect damage from non-Guardian enemies wielding [[Ancient Weapon]]s, and it caps at level three.

The following [[Armor]] pieces grant Guardian Resist Up in {{BotW|-}}:

* [[Ancient Helm]]
* [[Ancient Cuirass]]
* [[Ancient Greaves]]
* [[Diamond Circlet]]
* [[Vah Medoh Divine Helm]]
* [[Vah Naboris Divine Helm]]
* [[Vah Rudania Divine Helm]]
* [[Vah Ruta Divine Helm]]
* [[Midna's Helmet]]
